selectedText: We conducted an observational field study at two blue gum eucalyptus groves at Vandenberg Space Force Base during the 2023--2024 overwintering season. We used time-lapse imagery to derive a Butterfly Index (BI) of visible cluster size and paired changes in this index with nearby wind measurements across short and overnight timescales. The Wind Disruption Hypothesis predicts that greater wind exposure will precede consistent reductions in visible cluster size, with larger reductions at higher wind speeds. By directly monitoring visible clusters across a range of nearby wind conditions, we evaluated the central prediction of the Wind Disruption Hypothesis.
